meta.note: Existing corpus averages 381 words per post. Every new post targets 1200-1600 words with an FAQ block, because thin content is the single biggest reason the current 57 posts underperform. Clusters rotate: commercial -> condition -> audience -> local/english/seasonal.

clusters.commercial: Decision-stage queries. Someone comparing, pricing, or overcoming an objection before booking. Highest conversion value, weakest current coverage (only 2 of 57 posts).
clusters.condition: Symptom and diagnosis queries not yet covered by /sintomas or the blog. Volume driver, feeds the symptom hub.
clusters.audience: Life-stage and activity content that feeds the six /para-quien-sirve-la-quiropractica category hubs, which currently have almost no supporting posts.
clusters.local: Neighbourhood and Horta Sud queries. The Russafa and Eixample posts already prove the pattern; each new one must carry genuinely local detail, not a swapped place name.
clusters.english: EN-first content written for Valencia's expat and digital-nomad population. Today all 56 EN posts are translations of ES, so nothing targets how a foreigner actually searches.
clusters.seasonal: Calendar-anchored posts (Marató, Fallas, vuelta al cole, summer) published to land ahead of the demand spike.
